body_md:
Six HVAC listings that serve Jacksonville are here so you can compare the checked facts. Each names an owner and shows a Florida DBPR license recorded as current and active, plus a service area and phone number. Contacts were checked on November 14, 2026, and each fact set links to a DBPR source.

## How we picked

Listings are HVAC contractors with a named owner and a DBPR lookup. We recorded license type, number, and status, and used only the service area, hours, and features in the supplied facts. Each entry links to its DBPR record and website. Phones and sites were checked on 2026-11-14. Start years appear only when the facts included one.

## At a glance

- Certified Air Conditioning Contractors: Cool R Us, Inc. (CAC1815614), Whitley's Heating and Air LLC (CAC1816441), FL Cooling (CAC1813316), and Hot Heads Heating and Cooling, LLC (CAC1822691). Certified Mechanical Contractors: Ideal Conditions Heating & Air Conditioning Inc (CMC1250363) and AC Panda Mechanical Contractors LLC (CMC1251062). All six statuses are current and active.
- Jacksonville is in every service area. Cool R Us lists Duval, St. Johns, and Clay, plus Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Orange Park, Neptune Beach, Green Cove Springs, Middleburg, and St. Augustine. Ideal Conditions and Whitley's list Duval, Clay, Nassau, and St. Johns. AC Panda lists about 50 miles, including Orange Park, St. Augustine, Ponte Vedra, and Jacksonville Beach. FL Cooling lists the Beaches, Ponte Vedra, Nocatee, St. Johns, Orange Park, Fleming Island, Middleburg, Green Cove Springs, St. Augustine, and nearby communities. Hot Heads lists Mandarin, St. Augustine, Silverleaf, Julington Creek, World Golf Village, Orange Park, Fleming Island, and St. Johns, Clay, Duval, and Putnam counties.
- Where a start year is given: Cool R Us started in 2007, Ideal Conditions was founded in 2007, FL Cooling has been serving Jacksonville since 2009, and Whitley's was founded in 2010.
- Cool R Us is an Independent Trane Comfort Specialist dealer, and Ideal Conditions lists Trane as vendor. Whitley's is a Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer. AC Panda states that it services all major HVAC brands.

## Things to know before you go

Match the service-area line to your address. Nassau County is named by Ideal Conditions and Whitley's. Putnam County is named by Hot Heads. AC Panda describes about 50 miles. FL Cooling is described as a service-area business and names specific communities.

Read the hours line before an after-hours call. These facts include 24/7 emergency service for Cool R Us, Ideal Conditions, Whitley's, FL Cooling, and AC Panda. AC Panda also states a $350 non-member after-hours fee.

Ideal Conditions states a $49 homeowner diagnostic visit, waived when the repair is authorized. AC Panda states Peace of Mind maintenance at $279 per year residential and $379 commercial. FL Cooling states upfront pricing on its site. Cool R Us states that permits are pulled on replacement jobs.

NATE-certified technicians are listed by Cool R Us, Ideal Conditions, and Whitley's. Ideal Conditions also holds electrical license EC13011609. Whitley's also lists CAC1820505 on its site. FL Cooling's legal name on the state filing is Florida Cooling Store Inc., DBA FL Cooling. Hot Heads is family-owned, does residential and light commercial heating and cooling, publishes 561-723-9028, and has a license address at 102 Point Ida Ct, Interlachen, FL 32148, while serving Jacksonville. The other five street addresses are in Jacksonville.

## FAQ

### How do I confirm a license?

Open the DBPR source linked on the listing and match the license number and status. Each record here came from a DBPR lookup and was recorded as current and active. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-14.

### Which listings mention 24/7 emergency service?

Cool R Us, Ideal Conditions, Whitley's, FL Cooling, and AC Panda include it in these facts. FL Cooling also lists office hours Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM. AC Panda also lists Monday–Friday 8 am–5 pm, 24/7 emergency HVAC and electrical service, and a non-member after-hours fee of $350.

### Who is the named owner?

Named owners are Lek Gjoka (Cool R Us), Tom Massey (Ideal Conditions), John-Michael Williams and Brandy Williams (AC Panda), Raymond M. Whitley, Jr. (Whitley's), Eric Ancliffe (FL Cooling), and Rayce Allen Sexton (Hot Heads).
